DIAGNOSIS READY: Unconjugated Hyperbilirubinemia (Physiologic Neonatal Jaundice)

The baby is 5 days old, full-term, and exclusively breastfed with no signs of dehydration or abnormal stooling, which fits the classic presentation of physiologic jaundice. I will now monitor his bilirubin levels to ensure they do not reach toxic thresholds.
